title: The speed of biased random walk on leafless Bienaymé trees is monotone
abstract: Conditional on the two interval verifications of Appendix A, this Lean 4 and Mathlib formalization proves Theorem 1.1 of the paper. For every offspring law with no mass at zero and mean 1 < m < ∞, the speed v of the λ-biased random walk on the Bienaymé tree, constructed as the almost-sure limit of |X_n|/n, is positive and C^1 on [0, m) and strictly decreasing there, with v'(λ) < 0 for 0 < λ < m and right derivative -2 E[1/ν] at 0. The hypotheses are the closed propositions CertACovers and CertBCovers that the interval verifications of Lemmas A.1 and A.2 check, over all feasible normalized data; the proof derives the two lemmas from them at the actual law. The two propositions are proved in a companion repository, not in this one.
